theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the leading theme with strong absolute trend eligibility and high breadth, suggesting resilience in drawdowns. Although momentum rank has no return forecast edge, the risk-control gate supports staying with the trend. Crowding (z=1.05) warrants a size cap, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding could trigger a sharp but brief correction, and the mixed hurst regime suggests trend may not be strongly persistent.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO falls below its trend eligibility threshold (as determined by the absolute-trend gate) — i.e., the detector marks Big Banks as not eligible — or breadth collapses below 0.5.

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Telecom fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible false), has a very low durability bar (0.14), zero breadth, and a mean-reverting hurst tag, indicating elevated vulnerability to drawdowns. Underweighting mitigates downside risk.
theses.dissent: A mean-reversion bounce or sudden regulatory catalyst could cause a sharp snapback, though the risk-control gate suggests avoiding such exposures.

falsifier.text: Telecom becomes eligible (trend gate passes) or durability_bar rises above 0.5 and breadth increases above 0.5, signalling trend health.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
